description: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE. Use the type tool: type 'teller1' into the Operator ID field, type 'password' into the Password field, and type 'MAIN-001' into the Branch dropdown (it is a combobox — use the type tool, do not click an option). Then click Sign On. Finish once the main menu is shown.
